name: sourcebolt
description: Unofficial MCP server for Google NotebookLM: notebooks, sources, cited chat, research and notes.
long_description:
sourcebolt is a local MCP server for your own Google NotebookLM notebooks. It runs on your computer and talks only to NotebookLM, using your own Google session.

**Sign in first.** The extension cannot sign in for you. Install the sourcebolt command-line binary from the GitHub releases page and run `sourcebolt login --attach http://127.0.0.1:9222` (see docs/auth.md). The extension uses the same saved, encrypted session.

sourcebolt is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google. "NotebookLM" is a trademark of Google LLC.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Name of the saved sourcebolt sign-in profile to use (the --profile name given to sourcebolt login).
